B · per-agent attribution — savings rows joined to a call's agent

agent   tool      rows  joined via
------  --------  ----  ----------
claude  fux          1  call
claude  graphify     2  session

· coverage: 3 of 4 savings rows (75%) are agent-attributable
· agent-unknown: 1 graphify row(s) carry no call and no session
    — the interceptor runs as a subprocess and cannot know which agent spawned it
    (structural, not a capture gap)
· no savings row attributed to: copilot, kiro
    — this is NOT evidence they never invoked the tool: 1 row(s) above are
    agent-unknown and could belong to any of them.
